entity_policy: NO ENTITY PER SOURCE. The final write-up names no creature and says the glow is 'not known to be sentient'. Voices under the floor are draft TESTIMONY presented only as captioned hallucination audio near the glow. No bases, no NPCs.
notes: SOURCE (final revision): dank, dilapidated, cluttered attic; randomly shaped attic spaces packed with boxes and vintage furniture; exteriors damp and dusty, interiors pristine; boxes hold vital foods and catalogued objects; removed items may rot rapidly; decay effects (nausea, paranoia, dizziness, blackouts, hallucinations; physical decay unknown); the Orange Glow under some floorboards (comforting, alluring, rewrites memories, theorised to cause or amplify decay); no bases; exits by falling through non-glowing boards or crevices (38/202/432/654), occasional broken or damaged doors (289/5/12/20), handheld games or small arcade devices from boxes (40/212). Entrance from Level 1 by climbing into holes. TESTIMONY used as colour only: triangular ceilings tapering to the floor and empty door frames between areas; a floor mix of pink insulation and floorboards; tables, ottomans, bookcases, sofas with a care-home feel; tuna, water bottles and cooked gammon in boxes; no natural light, only a faint glow of unknown origin; voices calling from the glow (captioned hallucination only); the tablet found by a hole. ADAPTATION: the attic is a bounded seeded 5x5 grid of hip-roofed rooms joined by gable passages (layout grammar is ours; the page gives no map); the Level 5 door is placed two rooms from the arrival for the story spine, other broken doors and the single handheld game (40 or 212 by seed) are seeded; which fall destination a crevice leads to is seeded (the page lists four outcomes without saying which); rotten boards give way after about 1.4 s of standing (2.2x faster running); glow exposure, lure speed, decay rates and blackout timing are ours; the arrival hole is boarded shut behind you (draft: 'Getting in was fine getting out, though. That's going to be an issue.'); memory rewriting is shown as the tablet text changing and a rewritten memory of the arrival. Not built: the presumed-perimeter exit to Level 140 (blur/decay at the boundary). QA: in QA mode boards do not break and the lure/blackouts are off so the walker route is stable; the bot walks to the Level 5 door. RELEASE BOUNDARY: falling into a crevice whose destination is not built returns you to the last safe boards. Dev6: new inbound provisional start-position aliases (from_L018) are not custom-designed entrance geometry.
